name: How much does it cost to build an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build an attached ADU varies significantly based on factors like size, complexity of design, materials chosen, and site-specific conditions. Generally, costs can range from $100,000 to over $250,000. This includes design fees, permits, construction, and finishes. A detailed estimate requires an on-site evaluation and discussion of your specific project requirements. We provide transparent pricing after understanding your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for an attached ADU vary widely, typically ranging from $100,000 to over $250,000, depending on size, design, and materials.
